facts.fact: DLA Piper states that Cape Verde's Data Protection Law (Law 133/V/2001 as amended, including by Law 41/VIII/2013 and Law 121/IX/2021) permits international transfer of personal data only to a country with an adequate level of protection, or otherwise with the data subject's consent or in listed situations such as contract necessity or vital interests; the document gives no date for the rule, so its published date of 2025-01-16 is used.
